datasets.license: not stated in the Zenodo Rights field
datasets.notes: Existing experiments remain reproducibility records. Do not start new training, redistribute source data, or publish additional derived weights until the authors clarify permitted use.

datasets.name: Edinburgh Office Monitoring Video Dataset
datasets.notes: Nested leave-one-office-and-participant-out evaluation produced 0.5814 accuracy, 0.6050 macro-F1, and 0.2128 sitting recall, failing the 0.80 accuracy, 0.80 macro-F1, and 0.50 every-class-recall gate. No model is deployed or integrated. The fallen class is excluded because all 337 positive frames occur in one participant/office.

datasets.name: BEHAVE
datasets.evaluation: leave-one-participant-out over seven participants and 51 selected sequences
datasets.notes: A three-class transform-based auxiliary head was trained for seated contact, table lean and monitor interaction. Aggregate LOSO accuracy is 0.9310 and macro-F1 is 0.9077; every aggregate class recall exceeds 0.88. The predefined macro-F1 >= 0.85 and per-class recall >= 0.80 gate passed. The local model artifact is Git-ignored pending clarification of derived-weight redistribution.

datasets.name: COUCH MoCap NPZ release
datasets.license: non-commercial scientific research, education, and artistic projects
datasets.evaluation: planned leave-one-subject-out over six subjects; zero folds run because explicit targets are absent
datasets.notes: The official 336,578,531-byte archive passed SHA-256 and ZIP/schema checks. All 485 NPZ files contain pose, trans, R, t, start_idx and end_idx, but none contains a contact/interaction target. The published contact taxonomy cannot be reconstructed from filename tokens or geometry. Training is blocked until an official sequence-to-label manifest or full contact annotations are available.

datasets.name: Aria Digital Twin
datasets.notes: Use as a temporal/gaze auxiliary source, not as the fixed-camera primary domain.

datasets.name: NICR Multi-Task Dataset
datasets.notes: Not downloaded automatically because access requires a signed institutional request.

datasets.name: Human MotionLess Dataset (HuMoLs)
datasets.sample_unit: videos with one released silhouette mask each
datasets.license: official description permits free use with citation
datasets.evaluation: nested video-level stratified cross-validation; not subject-disjoint
datasets.notes: The release has no participant ID and only four standing videos. The v2 silhouette experiment failed its macro-F1/per-class-recall gate and is not deployed.
